milestones.title: The owner seeks a CAN/DGSI 100-8 SovereignReady review once the lab site's rows reach Met (O5, accepted 2026-11-25)

remediation: Every credible sovereignty label is issued by an assessor at a stated assurance level (CAN/DGSI 100-8 and its SovereignReady programme; the EU framework's assurance levels). The sovereignty card is a self-check from evidence and says so. The owner decided on 2026-11-25 (O5) to seek a CAN/DGSI 100-8 SovereignReady review once the lab site's rows reach Met; the card's scope line then names that assessment and its level. Sovereignty: assessments.
title: No independent sovereignty assessment exists; the sovereignty card is a self-check from evidence
